verdict.rationale: Twenty's cloud signup is described as spinning up a workspace in under a minute, and self-serve CSV/XLSX/XLS import includes column mapping, duplicate detection, and in-UI error fixing. Kanban views provide a pipeline board, and one community user called setup "extremely easy", though they hit small alpha-stage issues. missing for 10: evidence of an end-to-end under-an-hour time-to-value, a guided onboarding wizard, and direct importers from other CRMs (imports are one object per file and related records must be referenced by id, email, or domain, which adds manual prep).
